name: dylanmaudio-apps
description: Control the dylanmaudio apps: Console Bridge (formerly MIDI Bridge), Talk Light Trigger, Pilot Tone Trigger, Time Code Tool, Console Control and Show Recorder. Through Console Bridge it drives an Allen & Heath dLive with full state feedback, and with Console Bridge 1.5.0 or later an Allen & Heath Avantis or SQ, a Behringer WING, or a DiGiCo SD11 or Quantum 112. Requires the apps; it does not connect to a console directly.
